dogecoin.text:
Influential figures also play a big role.
Think of key opinion leaders on Twitter or Reddit.
When someone like Elon Musk tweets about Dogecoin $DOGE, you see immediate and often dramatic price movements.

In 2020 Musk hyped $DOGE on social media and SNL.
After it crashed, investors sued him, claiming they were misled Musk argued no reasonable investor would believe him and the judge dismissed the case
To taunt them
he had Trump create a fake Doge department
